sections.title: Prospectus Summary
sections.excerpt: Prospectus Summary This summary highlights information included in this prospectus and does not contain all of the information you should consider before investing in shares of our common stock. You should read this entire prospectus carefully, including the sections entitled “Risk Factors,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and the financial statements and the related notes included in this prospectus before you decide to invest in shares of our common stock. Overview Our mission is to create and deliver the most advanced healing technologies in the world. sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt: Dividend Policy We have not declared any cash dividends since inception and do not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future. The payment of cash dividends is within the discretion of the Board of Directors and will depend on our earnings, capital requirements, financial condition, and other relevant factors. There are no restrictions that currently limit our ability to pay cash, or other, dividends on our common stock other than those generally imposed by applicable state law.
